events.evidence: It is reported that Saudi Arabia launched retaliatory strikes against Iran in response to Iranian strikes on the country during the war
British defence secretary John Healey announces that the United Kingdom has deployed Typhoon fighter jets and the Royal Navy destroyer HMS Dragon as part of a mission to secure the Strait of Hormuz
Russian president Vladimir Putin says Russia will deploy new Sarmat nuclear missiles this year

label.note: Saudi retaliation, Hormuz military deployment and Russian nuclear missile warning sharply raise geopolitical risk.
